description: This is a shell script that initializes an Android TV project by setting up directory structure, downloading dependencies, creating configuration files, and generating boilerplate code for an Android TV application with a rating screen placeholder.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for Android TV, extends FragmentActivity, handles remote input, and displays project name.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, and initializes UI components.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote key events such as select, back, and directional controls.
